parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The batch description. The description must be 1 to 64 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If this parameter is unavailable, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

parameters.name: ScheduleCode
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the schedule.

parameters.name: Total
parameters.description: The number of sound codes to create in batches. Valid values: 1 to 200. The system automatically generates a label for each sound code that consists of a random combination of letters and digits.
